reviewer: first review: independent blind review by a separate Claude agent (did not see the automatic labels); every prediction was run read-only on its database. Second check: Claude (the assistant that built the taxonomy), with the automatic and first-review labels visible, judged by the taxonomy definitions in specs §8.4; disputed rows were re-run on their databases. The author delegated the spot-check; no human review.
rule_fix: EM-correct/EX-wrong predictions were all labelled value_error; EM ignores join columns, so 7 wrong-direction joins (network_1) were mislabelled. The rule now compares structure first and uses value_error only when nothing else differs. The fix was found on this sample, so the post-fix agreement is optimistic.
